hooks.command: file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.sol) echo '⚠️ Solidity file modified — run /security-audit before deploy' ;; */signing/*|*/keys/*|*/crypto/*|*/seed*) echo '🔴 SECURITY-CRITICAL file modified: '$file' — crypto-security-auditor review required' ;; *.env*|*secret*|*credential*) echo '🚨 SENSITIVE FILE TOUCHED: '$file' — verify no secrets committed' ;; esac

cmd="$CLAUDE_BASH_COMMAND"; case "$cmd" in *'npm publish'*|*'yarn publish'*) echo '⚠️ PUBLISH detected — verify npm audit clean and no secrets in package' ;; *'docker push'*) echo '⚠️ Docker push — verify no secrets baked into image' ;; *'--force'*|*'-f'*) echo '⚠️ Force flag detected — destructive operation, verify intent' ;; esac
file="$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH"; case "$file" in *.env|*.env.*|*credentials*|*secrets*) echo 'BLOCK: Cannot write to sensitive file '$file' — use Vault or env vars' && exit 1 ;; esac; exit 0

if command -v osascript &>/dev/null; then osascript -e 'display notification "'"$CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION"'" with title "Claude Code"'; elif command -v notify-send &>/dev/null; then notify-send 'Claude Code' "$CLAUDE_NOTIFICATION"; fi
